basic_info.description: This sunny sanctuary in Bernal Heights blends thoughtful updates and versatile indoor/outdoor living spaces, in a vibrant neighborhood just three blocks from Cortland Ave shops, dining and cafes. Main level features an open-plan kitchen and dining area with expansive windows and a skylight, plus two bright bedrooms with garden views and a full bath. You'll love the remodeled kitchen with Fireclay tile, contemporary cabinetry, and upgraded stainless appliances incl. Samsung 5-burner gas range and built-in Kucht microwave drawer. Downstairs, the remodeled primary suite with full bath opens to the sunny, fully landscaped backyard, complete with an Ipe wood deck, spacious patio, built-in planters and a grape arbor. A custom, insulated office shed with a green roof and custom Pella windows offers a tranquil retreat for work or creativity. Recent upgrades include enhanced siding with added insulation; remodeled mudroom, lower bath, and walk-in; newer washer and dryer; new kitchen in 2022; new roof in 2021. One-car garage with storage and laundry. Solar panels. Enjoy Bernal's sunny microclimate and easy access to freeways, farmer's market, Holly Park, and Bernal Hill with panoramic city views. Comfort, style, and ample community charm, this is a very special home!
